scope: Analyze overlap, decomposition, and factual-return consistency in the single frozen V2 Case 01 ledger; specify the narrowest safe next candidate without implementing it.

observed_ledger.component_relationship: P1-P3 partition the same sentence whose complete span is P4.
observed_ledger.contradiction: P1-P3 call the figurative components new unsupported real-world commitments while P4 says the integrated construction carries no real-world commitment.

root_cause_findings.finding: The model converted figurative predicates into candidate propositions by near-literal paraphrase: hidden money, exposed employees, and a hotel needing transparency.
root_cause_findings.distinction: A grammatical subject-predicate surface is not sufficient evidence of real-world commitment.

root_cause_findings.finding: The money/shadow, employees/light, and room/transparency relations were classified separately before their shared contrast and wordplay were recognized as one creative host.
root_cause_findings.impact: Decomposition destroyed the pragmatic force that determines whether the components return to factual assertion.

root_cause_findings.finding: The ledger has spans and independence groups but no explicit host/embedded relationship or consistency receipt for overlapping entries.
root_cause_findings.impact: A COMPLETE ledger can contain mutually incompatible interpretations of the same words.

root_cause_findings.finding: P1-P3 share G1 despite expressing three purported propositions, while the creative host uses G2. The current contract cannot distinguish dimensions of one proposition from components of one construction.
All component entries use null authority support even though the governed summary supplies the story event transformed by the metaphor.
root_cause_findings.boundary: Semantic correspondence does not by itself turn a creative vehicle into a factual assertion; authority alignment and communicative role are separate decisions.

governing_principles: Overlap is not inherently invalid. A creative host may contain a genuinely asserted, presupposed, entailed, or necessarily implied real-world proposition.
Literalizing a metaphor, analogy, personification, hyperbole, counterfactual, wordplay, or editorial vehicle does not create a factual-return proposition.

A component becomes a REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT only when its real-world proposition survives removal or neutralization of the creative vehicle and remains truth-evaluable from the commentary's communicative force.
A governed factual reference inside creative language is not unsupported merely because it reuses story entities or concepts. It must align to exact factual authority when support is claimed.
A COMPLETE ledger must reconcile every overlapping interpretation; contradictory role assignments cannot coexist silently.

sequence: Identify the smallest integrated creative host whose components jointly produce the transformation.
State the alleged real-world proposition without treating the creative vehicle as literal.
Ask whether the candidate still asserts, presupposes, entails, or necessarily implies that proposition after the vehicle is neutralized.
If the proposition disappears or reduces to a description of the vehicle, keep only CONTAINED_CREATIVE for that content.
If the proposition survives, inventory it separately and record its relationship to the creative host.
Align any claimed support to the immutable authority; unsupported return remains a real-world entry, not a creative exemption.

component_results.money_hidden: NO_INDEPENDENT_FACTUAL_RETURN; metaphorical presentation of the governed off-books-payment event.
component_results.employees_in_light: NO_INDEPENDENT_FACTUAL_RETURN; contrastive vehicle, not an assertion of physical exposure or a new employee status.
component_results.hotel_needs_transparency_room: NO_INDEPENDENT_FACTUAL_RETURN; personified wordplay and editorial judgment, not a literal hotel need or event.

case01_application.required_shape: One or more contained-creative entries may describe the integrated transformation; zero unsupported REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT entries; COMPLETE review.

legitimate_overlap_examples.example: Compania, care a concediat 40 de oameni ieri, și-a pus empatia la păstrare.
legitimate_overlap_examples.analysis: The dismissal clause remains factual when the empathy metaphor is removed. It may be a governed REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT nested within a creative host.

legitimate_overlap_examples.example: Primarul, supărat că a pierdut alegerile, și-a descoperit brusc modestia.
legitimate_overlap_examples.analysis: The attributed emotion and election outcome survive removal of the editorial framing and must be inventoried if unsupported.

legitimate_overlap_examples.example: Bugetul intră pe ușă și transparența iese pe geam.
legitimate_overlap_examples.analysis: Door/window components are not separately real-world events merely because they have verbs.

recommended_contract_candidate.name: STAGE_P_SCOPE_GRAPH_V1
entry_additions: creative_host_entry_id: null or P1-P8; required for FACTUAL_RETURN_WITHIN_CREATIVE_HOST
factual_return_basis: NOT_APPLICABLE, ASSERTION_SURVIVES, PRESUPPOSITION_SURVIVES, ENTAILMENT_SURVIVES, NECESSARY_IMPLICATION_SURVIVES, UNRESOLVED
deterministic_invariants: Every creative_host_entry_id refers to an existing CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry.
The referenced creative host span contains or overlaps the factual-return span.
FACTUAL_RETURN_WITHIN_CREATIVE_HOST cannot use factual_return_basis NOT_APPLICABLE or UNRESOLVED in a COMPLETE ledger.
CONTAINED_CREATIVE uses scope_relation CREATIVE_HOST or STANDALONE and factual_return_basis NOT_APPLICABLE.
UNRESOLVED_RELATION or unresolved factual-return basis forces INDETERMINATE.
COMPLETE requires all three new scope receipts true.
Entry identifiers and host references are acyclic; an entry cannot host itself.
Independence groups cannot be used as a substitute for host/component relations.
semantic_requirements: The commitment text for a factual return states a truth-evaluable real-world proposition, not a literal paraphrase of the creative words.
The stated factual-return basis must survive creative-vehicle neutralization.
A whole creative host and overlapping real-world entry may coexist only when the real-world entry passes that test.
Stage C must later audit these claims against original inputs and may not trust the scope graph as authority.
recommended_contract_candidate.fail_closed: Unreconciled overlap, unresolved host relation, missing host, cyclic host reference, or uncertain factual return yields INDETERMINATE and prevents Stage C invocation under current precedence.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Ban all overlapping creative and real-world spans
rejected_shortcuts.reason: Would hide genuine factual clauses and unsupported presuppositions embedded in creative language.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Deterministically delete component entries when a whole creative span exists
rejected_shortcuts.reason: Would silently repair model evidence and could erase unsafe embedded propositions.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Treat authority correspondence as proof of factual assertion
rejected_shortcuts.reason: A metaphor can transform governed facts without reasserting its vehicle literally.

rejected_shortcuts.shortcut: Solve with lexical rules for metaphor words
rejected_shortcuts.reason: The capability is pragmatic scope reasoning, not vocabulary routing.

verification_requirements: Frozen Case 01 fixture reaches its required contained-creative shape without component literalization.
Governed literal clause embedded in a creative host remains representable and source-aligned.
Unsupported presupposition embedded in a creative host remains representable and cannot be hidden.
Pure creative components with verbs do not require real-world entries.
Missing, self, cyclic, non-creative, and non-overlapping host references fail deterministically.
Multiple valid segmentations remain allowed when they produce the same reconciled scope graph.
Expected labels and cases remain hidden from the generation path.
bounded_next_step_if_authorized: Implement an evaluation-only Stage P Scope Graph V1 schema and construction fixtures only. Perform zero-inference schema/invariant feasibility and constrained-grammar design; do not modify the prompt or bind a model runner until owner review of the schema evidence.
